observations.rendererIndependence: Agent production presentation code has no dependency path into modules/renderer; model script nodes are removed, output actions cannot route through the main-chat chatManager, browser-only image/color APIs fail quietly when unavailable, and governance plus isolation/lifecycle suites enforce the boundary
observations.runtimeGenerationBarrier: once Renderer knows the active Runtime generation, generation-less and older Projection Patches fail closed and trigger authoritative SQLite reload; the first Patch from a newer generation advances Renderer authority
observations.unknownItemDiagnostics: unknown Codex Items render through a bounded sanitized fallback and emit one bounded metadata-only protocol diagnostic per Thread/Item/type identity; raw field values are excluded
observations.snapshotBarrier: waterline-newer projection.updated events buffered during cold read or Session switch are replayed through the same revision Patch reducer as ordinary live events
observations.timelineOrder: tool cards are Turn-local timeline Blocks, rendered after the reasoning or assistant message that initiated the call and before the assistant continuation that consumes its result; partial and full reconciliation preserve those live anchors, Main startup and first authoritative read transactionally repair recognizable legacy top-clustered rows, and a full Electron exit/relaunch with the same AppData preserved 13 tool cards including the real 11-card/five-batch shape with exact timeline kind and Block identity order; completed-message presentation patches reassert coordinator-owned DOM keys instead of leaving only tool rows with stable identity
observations.configDiagnostics: Advanced settings read authoritative desired/applied config and revisions, Runtime generation, storage state and sanitized endpoint/errors; Adapter diagnostics query by authoritative Thread identity and Main rewrites Codex metadata identity to the owning VChat Session; prompt content is represented only by configured/length descriptors, workspace uses a basename-like display, exact difference fields come from Main, reapply accepts only Session identity, and stale Session responses are rejected. Real Electron smoke renders an apply-timeout error in the 139 px sidebar, verifies impact/next-step guidance, full-code tooltip, default collapse and expanded sanitized details without horizontal overflow, and records light/dark visual evidence
